scope: test/r7a2-interruption.test.mjs + test/r7a1-correction.test.mjs + test/r7a1-composition.test.mjs against single-piece removals of the R7-A.2 interruption model in a temporary copy

results.mutation: I1 identity ignored: every report is a new break

R7-A.2 I4: a return reads the executions recorded by its report; a newer report of the same break reads the ones recorded later
R7-A.2 I1: a report of a break that ended before the latest reported one began is asked, never guessed
